title: Update a Repository Git Reference
knowledge:
# Update a Repository Git Reference

## Prerequisites

- You must have permission to update Git references in the target repository.

## Method

`PATCH`

## URL

`https://api.github.com/repos/{{owner}}/{{repo}}/git/refs/{{ref}}`

## Headers

```json
{
  "Accept": "application/json",
  "Content-Type": "application/json"
}
```

## Description

Updates the provided Git reference to point to a new SHA. This can be used to move a branch or tag ref, optionally forcing the update.

## Enforcement Rules

- The `owner` path parameter **must always be present**.
- The `repo` path parameter **must always be present**.
- The `ref` path parameter **must always be present**.
- Do **not** call the API with missing or empty path parameters (e.g., avoid `/repos//...`, `/git/refs/` with an empty `ref`).
- Always construct the path as `/repos/{{owner}}/{{repo}}/git/refs/{{ref}}`, where each path parameter is a **non-empty string**.
- When executing the action, ensure to send **Path Parameters in the URL and not in the body**.
- When executing the action, ensure to send **Query Parameters as URL query parameters and not in the body** (this endpoint does not document any query parameters).

### Valid Examples

```http
/repos/octocat/Hello-World/git/refs/heads/feature-a
/repos/my-org/my-repo/git/refs/tags/v1.2.3
```

### Invalid Examples

```http
/repos//Hello-World/git/refs/heads/feature-a
/repos/octocat//git/refs/heads/feature-a
/repos/octocat/Hello-World/git/refs/
/repos/octocat/Hello-World/git/refs
```

## Required Path Parameters

| Parameter | Type   | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `owner` | string | The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive. |
| `repo` | string | The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive. |
| `ref` | string | The Git reference (example: `heads/feature-a`). For more information, see Git References in the Git documentation. |

## Required Request Body Fields

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `sha` | string | The SHA1 value to set this reference to. |

## Optional Request Body Fields

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `force` | boolean | Indicates whether to force the update or to make sure the update is a fast-forward update. Default: `false`. Leaving this out or setting it to `false` will make sure you're not overwriting work. |

## Response

### Success Response (200 OK)

```json
{
  "ref": "refs/heads/feature-a",
  "node_id": "MDM6UmVmMTIzNDU2Nzg5OnJlZnMvaGVhZHMvZmVhdHVyZS1h",
  "url": "https://api.github.com/repos/octocat/Hello-World/git/refs/heads/feature-a",
  "object": {
    "type": "commit",
    "sha": "aa218f56b14c9653891f9e74264a383fa43fefbd",
    "url": "https://api.github.com/repos/octocat/Hello-World/git/commits/aa218f56b14c9653891f9e74264a383fa43fefbd"
  }
}
```

### Error Response (409 Conflict)

```json
{
  "message": "Conflict",
  "documentation_url": "https://docs.github.com/rest/git/refs#update-a-reference",
  "url": "https://api.github.com/repos/octocat/Hello-World/git/refs/heads/feature-a",
  "status": "409"
}
```

### Error Response (422 Unprocessable Entity)

```json
{
  "message": "Validation Failed",
  "documentation_url": "https://docs.github.com/rest/git/refs#update-a-reference",
  "errors": [
    {
      "resource": "Reference",
      "field": "sha",
      "message": "Invalid SHA",
      "code": "invalid",
      "index": 0,
      "value": "not-a-sha"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Response Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ref` | string | The full Git reference name. |
| `node_id` | string | The node ID of the reference. |
| `url` | string | API URL for the reference. |
| `object` | object | The Git object the reference points to. |
| `object.type` | string | Type of the referenced object. |
| `object.sha` | string | SHA for the reference. Must be exactly 40 characters (minLength=40, maxLength=40). |
| `object.url` | string | API URL for the referenced object. |

## Sample Request

```bash
curl -i --location --request PATCH 'https://api.github.com/repos/octocat/Hello-World/git/refs/heads/feature-a' \
  --header 'Accept: application/json' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{
    "sha": "aa218f56b14c9653891f9e74264a383fa43fefbd",
    "force": true
  }'
```

## Example Usage

### Example 1: Fast-forward update (force omitted; defaults to false)

```bash
curl -i --location --request PATCH 'https://api.github.com/repos/octocat/Hello-World/git/refs/heads/feature-a' \
  --header 'Accept: application/json' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{
    "sha": "aa218f56b14c9653891f9e74264a383fa43fefbd"
  }'
```

### Example 2: Force update the ref to a specific commit SHA

```bash
curl -i --location --request PATCH 'https://api.github.com/repos/octocat/Hello-World/git/refs/heads/feature-a' \
  --header 'Accept: application/json' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{
    "sha": "aa218f56b14c9653891f9e74264a383fa43fefbd",
    "force": true
  }'
```

## Notes

- `force=false` (default) helps prevent overwriting work by requiring a fast-forward update.
- The `ref` path parameter is expected in the form shown in the docs example (e.g., `heads/feature-a`).

## Error Handling

- **409 Conflict**: The update could not be applied due to a conflict.
- **422 Unprocessable Entity**: Validation failed, or the endpoint has been spammed.
